rival_reading: A changed shift credential and return rule may follow an ordinary field warning; the late copy does not prove officials mishandled a containment order.
gloss: A dispatch credential records a late instruction revision beside a private meal note.
title: Eli Navarro
body: Revised route copy arrived after the first was sent; key due at close. Dispatch clerk, late shift. Reverse note: save half the lunch for my son.

rival_reading: An agricultural warning could travel through the same desk; an old copy and late receipt may reflect routine message delay rather than a failed evacuation.
gloss: An earlier route instruction remains beneath its revision beside a personal trace and a key return.
title: Revision filed beneath the old order
body: Eli's route sheet keeps the earlier road instruction beneath the revision. A child's drawing is folded inside the clipboard; the only completed field counts returned keys, not deliveries.
